protocol: Read shards and articles in source order. Strip only outer whitespace from text; no title prefix or normalization. Deduplicate SHA-256 of trimmed text before split. Big-endian first 8 SHA bytes modulo 100: 0 dev, 1 test, 2..99 train. Keep complete articles until each target is met. 100MB train is a strict prefix of 1GB train. Dev/test independently capped at 5MB. This is a source-prefix sample, not a random sample of all Wikipedia. No near-duplicate or BLiMP contamination audit.
